title: Gwinnett couple warn others after losing $800K in cryptocurrency scam

reading.body:
This incident shows a failure in the trust mechanisms of financial software. A fake AI-generated website displayed false account balances to a user, creating the appearance of legitimate investment returns when none existed. The deception worked because the fraudulent interface looked real enough to convince the victim to increase his deposits over time.

The failure occurred at the point where a user needed to verify he was looking at genuine financial data. No authentication, independent confirmation, or human advisor checked whether the trading platform was legitimate before the victim transferred large sums. Catching this would have required either verification of the platform's identity before any money moved, or a review process that confirmed the account balances against the actual brokerage records.

It is not established whether the mobile trading app itself was compromised or whether scammers merely impersonated a legitimate platform entirely. The role of AI in generating the fake website is reported but its specific function is not detailed.

reports.title: Georgia couple loses $800K in sophisticated cryptocurrency scam
Gwinnett couple warn others after losing $800K in cryptocurrency scam

summary:
A retired Georgia couple lost nearly $800,000 in a cryptocurrency scam that started with a WhatsApp message from a stranger. The scammer convinced Jerry Dunaway to download a mobile trading app and invest money, initially allowing him to make small trades and withdraw funds to build trust. Over time, Jerry invested increasingly larger amounts, believing he was seeing real returns on a legitimate platform.

The couple discovered the fraud when Jerry tried to withdraw more money and couldn't access his funds. Police explained that while the trading app was real, scammers had created a fake AI-generated site that showed false investment balances on Jerry's screen. The Dunaways are now speaking publicly to warn others about the sophisticated tactics used by these criminals. Although they are working with Gwinnett County police, investigators say victims in these cases rarely recover their money. Their children started a GoFundMe to help the couple with daily expenses.
